g.text: QD-DETR | Four-route Standard Test (Stage 2 Val-selected epoch 3)
Standard Test: 1,036 queries (544 positive / 492 negative), 101 thresholds. Dotted vertical line / large marker: protocol threshold 0.4.
Comparison: original GMR, D-GMR joint, D-GMR detach, and D-GMR two-stage. Each trained route uses its own recorded Val-selected checkpoint; this sweep does not reselect checkpoints.
